<h1 class="postTitle al dark-gray fl">Football Statistics</h1><span class="fl sm-invisible ml05 dark-gray" style="font-size:1.6em;">-</span><h2 class="postTitle al dark-gray fl sm-invisible ml05">League and Team Stats</h2> <p class="cb dark-gray small lh14e">FootyStats is the premier football stats and analysis site, with data coverage in 500+ football leagues worldwide including UK, Europe, and South America. Team stats, League stats, and Player stats are covered with details on form, goals scored, conceded, shots, xG, corner stats, and more. You can also download the data using our CSV or API service.</p>

<h2 class="header al pl05e">Football Stats by FootyStats</h2>
<div class="widget-content al">
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray">Soccer Stats for leagues and cups around the world</h2><p class="lh14e mt1e">FootyStats covers over 345 major &amp; minor football leagues and cups - ranging from <a href="https://footystats.org/england/premier-league">England's Premier League</a> to <a href="https://footystats.org/brazil/serie-a">Brazil's domestic Serie A</a>. By calculating and generating match data for Over/Under, Both Teams to Score (BTTS), Clean Sheets and Head to Heads, we guarantee that our team stats, form and league standings are accurate and up-to-date.</p><p class="mt05e lh14e">We also provide analysis for in-play statistics, which will inform you at which point in a match a team scores or concedes their goals across the season. This feature is handy for understanding in-play dynamics of each football team.</p><p class="lh14e mt05e">That’s not all! Be sure also to check out our latest football tips, selected using our data and stats, as well as enjoying a read of our <a href="/blog/">football blog</a>.</p>
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray mt2e">What Soccer Stats / Football Stats do you have?</h2>
<p class="lh14e mt1e">We have over 500 data points per league, team, and players! Yes that's right - three whole hundred data points! It's quite overwhelming at first but here are some of the most used datas :
    		<a href="https://footystats.org/stats/over-under">Over 0.5 ~ 5.5 stats</a>, <a href="https://footystats.org/stats/btts-stats">BTTS stats</a>, <a href="https://footystats.org/stats/clean-sheet-stats">Clean Sheets</a>, League Tables, <a href="https://footystats.org/england/premier-league/form-table">Form Tables</a>, <a href="https://footystats.org/clubs/england/manchester-city-fc">In-Play Data</a>, Goals Per match, Conceded per match, <a href="https://footystats.org/players/france/anthony-martial">Goals / match for Players</a>, <a href="https://footystats.org/stats/card-stats">Yellow / Red Cards</a>, and even <a href="https://footystats.org/stats/corner-stats">Corner Stats</a>! The possibilities with these data are endless. We even have odds so that you can compare them against the stats at a glance to see if they provide value. What's more? We make every single one of these data public through our API and CSVs which will be available later this year. We encourage you to use our data to do your own soccer stats analysis such as machine learning and model based predictions. Shots and posession data will be available later this year as well.</p>
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray mt2e">Our Data update frequency</h2>
<p class="lh14e mt1e">We update our stats every 10 ~ 20 minutes! Other stats services update once a week, or once a day. We update within 10 minutes of matches ending and our users love us for it. We're also continually working to update our stats at an even faster rate. Other data platforms like soccerstats update much slower than FootyStats. Our aim is to update our stats every 2 minutes in the future.</p>
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray mt2e">Importance of football data in making predictions</h2>
<p class="lh14e mt1e">History is the best predicting indicator of our future. Whatever patterns that happened in the past usually happens in the present. Football / Soccer is an exciting sport and it is not an exception to this rule. We believe that by using our statistics for your football predictions, you have a much better chance of getting them right. - whether it be for fantasy sports or others. There are no other services that have as much of a complete data as we do for making assumptions about what the match outcome is going to be for today's matches. For example if Manchester United has scored over 1.5 goals for their last 5 matches - it's very likely that this will happen again soon in the future. Stats enable intelligent, and correct football predictions.
    	</p>
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray mt2e">Daily, Accurate Football Predictions</h2>
<p class="lh14e mt1e">We provide frequent football predictions as part of our public and premium services. Our <a href="https://footystats.org/data-based-predictions">Data-Based Predictions</a> are updated everyday with the most accurate and high yield soccer predictions. Our soccer predictions are accompanied by logic and explanations supporting the prediction - so not only do you get accurate predictions, you also learn how to think in terms of making future predictions!</p>
<p class="lh14e mt1e pb1e">The form numbers on the home page change after the match because we can only store 1 form per team per season. This may get resolved in the future.</p>
<h2 class="body-size lh14e dark-gray mt2e">Continuing expansion of the FootyStats data platform</h2>
<p class="lh14e mt1e pb1e">We're dedicated to expanding our line of services for our soccer data lovers. We currently provide critical soccer stats in CSV forms and are planning to launch an API(JSON/XML) in the coming months. Our dataset will have an incredible line of stats for soccer competitions including league stats for <a href="https://footystats.org/usa/mls">Major League Soccer</a> and 200+ other competitions. Each league's teams, their performances, and even the players' performances will be recorded in our data. We're also creating football widgets for webmasters to use our data on their own website as well. 
    	</p>

<div class="widget mt3e">
<h2 class="header al pl05e">What are Soccer Stats For?</h2>
<div class="widget-content al">
						Soccer Stats is often used by pundits, prediction makers, and journalists to make informed decisions on future soccer/football outcomes. For example, journalists often quote stats such as Goals per Match to indicate how well a Striker is performing. On the other hand, an average Joe may use soccer stats such as Over 2.5 or BTTS % to predict the outcome of an upcoming match. Soccer Stats can be useful for any persons interested in learning about the context of a soccer match. FootyStats provides hundreds of data points for over 450 leagues across the world.					</div>
